**Finding: compliant** (RENEWAL — Auto-renewal and non-renewal notice window)

- **Where:** § 12.1.1 (Term) and § 12.1.2 (Effect of Expiration), paragraphs p0582–p0583.
- **Why compliant at the preferred position:** The Term is definite — it runs to expiry of the last Royalty Term for the last Licensed Product, or lapse of the License Option Period. There is no automatic renewal, no non-renewal notice window, and no renewal price-uplift language anywhere in the document (searches for "renew" and "automatically" surfaced only regulatory-filing renewals and unrelated automatic-effect provisions). Any extension would require a mutual written amendment under § 13.9, which is exactly the playbook's preferred outcome.
- **Note in our favour:** § 12.1.2 provides that on expiry under clause (a) our grants under § 5.1.3 become non-exclusive, fully-paid, royalty-free and irrevocable — no renewal is needed to preserve our rights.

No redline proposed.
